_meta.description: Shopify blog publishing defaults for Innova Retail. Used by shopify-draft.json generator and future n8n/Zapier/Make automation workflows.
_meta.usage: These are defaults only. Per-article overrides go in the article's shopify-draft.json.

review_checklist: Verify live pricing against current Innova Retail inventory
Check all internal links return 200 in browser
Confirm no duplicate H1 in Shopify blog template

n8n.auth: Shopify credentials (API key + password or access token)

field_reference.article.title: Blog post title — shown in Shopify blog listing and browser tab
field_reference.article.author: Author name displayed on the post
field_reference.article.body_html: Full HTML content — paste-ready, no html/head/body tags
field_reference.article.tags: Comma-separated or array — used for Shopify blog filtering
field_reference.article.metafields: SEO title and description stored as metafields (see seo block below)
field_reference.article.image: Featured image — must be uploaded separately; not included in draft JSON
